Objective: Place an order with one valid cargo item
Input: Customer "Le Mai Chi", chi@example.com, 0901234567; valid OfferingId; pickup "12 Tran Duy Hung, Hanoi"; delivery "45 Le Loi, HCMC"; cargo [Boxed goods, 250kg]
Expected Output: 201 Created; Order status Pending; Shipment created and attached; Invoice created at offering BasePrice; AuditRecord Order null -> Pending
Actual Output: As expected. Order.OrderWeightKg = 250 derived from cargo; one Shipment and one Invoice persisted

Objective: Reject an order with no cargo items
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "Order must contain at least one cargo item."
Actual Output: 400 with that message (DTO [MinLength(1)] also rejects before the coordinator is reached)

Objective: Reject cargo heavier than the offering allows
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "WeightKg 1500 exceeds offering limit of 1000."

Objective: Reject cargo volume above the offering limit only when volume is supplied
Input: Offering MaxVolumeCbm = 10; cargo VolumeCbm = 25; second run with VolumeCbm = null
Expected Output: 409 Conflict for 25; order accepted when VolumeCbm is null

Objective: Reject a declared order weight that disagrees with the cargo total
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Order weight 300kg must match the combined cargo weight of 250kg."

Objective: Reject a non-existent offering
Input: OfferingId = a random GUID not in the catalogue
Expected Output: 404 Not Found; "Offering {id} not found."

Objective: Reject a malformed customer email
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; ValidationProblemDetails; "The CustomerEmail field is not a valid e-mail address."

Objective: Reject non-positive cargo weight
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; Range violation on WeightKg (domain guard "WeightKg must be positive." behind it)

Objective: Reuse an existing customer rather than duplicating
Input: Place a second order using an email already on file
Expected Output: No new Customer row; the existing CustomerId is reused on the new order

Objective: Reject a blank pickup address
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request from ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace

Objective: Customer views order status and details
Expected Output: 200 OK with order status plus its Cargoes; Shipments and Invoice

Objective: Customer lists their own orders by email
Expected Output: 200 OK with only that customer's orders

Objective: Unknown order returns not found
Expected Output: 404 Not Found

Objective: Create an assignment binding driver; vehicle and shipments
Input: One unassigned ShipmentId; an available DriverId and VehicleId
Expected Output: 201 Created; Assignment status Pending; Shipment status Assigned; Order status Approved; Driver.IsAvailable false; Vehicle status Assigned
Actual Output: As expected; three AuditRecords written (Assignment; Driver; Vehicle)

Objective: Reject double-booking a driver who already has an active assignment
Input: A DriverId already bound to a Pending assignment
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Driver {id} already has an active assignment."

Objective: Reject double-booking a vehicle
Input: A VehicleId already bound to a Pending assignment
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Vehicle {id} already has an active assignment."

Objective: Reject a shipment already attached to another assignment
Input: A ShipmentId whose AssignmentId is already set
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Shipment {id} is already assigned."

Objective: Allow the same driver and vehicle to be reused after delivery
Input: Deliver the first assignment; then create a second with the same driver and vehicle
Expected Output: Second assignment created successfully
Actual Output: As expected (Delivered and Rejected are excluded from the active check)

Objective: Reject staging when shipment weight exceeds warehouse capacity
Input: warehouseId supplied; combined order weight above Warehouse.CapacityKg
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Shipment weight {x}kg exceeds warehouse '{name}' capacity of {y}kg."

Objective: Create a direct assignment with no route
Input: No route object in the request body
Expected Output: 201 Created; Assignment.RouteId is null

Objective: Persist an inline route and return it on the assignment
Input: route { origin; destination; waypoints[]; distanceKm; estimatedDurationMinutes }
Expected Output: Route persisted; returned nested in AssignmentResponse
Actual Output: As expected; waypoints stored as WaypointsJson

Objective: Reject a route with a blank origin address
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request from ArgumentException

Objective: Reject a non-positive route distance when provided
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "DistanceKm must be positive when provided."

Objective: Approve a pending assignment and activate its orders
Expected Output: 200 OK; Assignment status Assigned; each linked Order moves Approved -> Active
Actual Output: As expected; audit rows written for assignment and each order

Objective: Reject approving an assignment that is not pending
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Only a pending assignment can be approved."

Objective: Reject an assignment with no shipments
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "At least one shipment is required."

Objective: Filter assignments by driver
Expected Output: 200 OK returning only that driver's assignments

Objective: Create a load manifest once and reuse it
Input: Fetch the manifest for a shipment twice
Expected Output: Same manifest returned both times; no duplicate row
Actual Output: As expected; manifest itemises the order's cargo

Objective: Tick cargo items as loaded
Input: A list of valid CargoIds from the manifest
Expected Output: 200 OK; LoadedCargoIds updated

Objective: Reject a loaded item that is not on the manifest
Input: A CargoId belonging to a different order
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "loadedCargoIds contains an id not present on this manifest."

Objective: Reject completing loading while items remain unchecked
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "All cargo items must be checked as loaded before starting."

Objective: Complete loading once every item is ticked
Expected Output: 200 OK; IsPickupResolved true; Assignment status Assigned -> Loaded

Objective: Reject starting the trip before loading is confirmed
Input: A shipment whose manifest is unresolved
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Cannot start trip before loading is confirmed."

Objective: Start the trip after loading is confirmed
Expected Output: 200 OK; Shipment status InTransit; Assignment status Loaded -> Delivering

Objective: Record damaged or missing items at drop-off
Expected Output: 200 OK; IsDropoffResolved true; the note stored against the manifest
Actual Output: As expected; no duplicate manifest row created

Objective: Confirm delivery and fulfil the order
Input: driverId of the assigned driver; recipientName; proofSignature; optional GPS lat/lon
Expected Output: 201 Created; Shipment Delivered; Assignment Delivered; Order Fulfilled; driver and vehicle released to Available
Actual Output: As expected; damaged-item notes carried across from the manifest

Objective: Reject a delivery confirmation from a driver who is not assigned
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "Driver is not assigned to this shipment."

Objective: Accept a delivery confirmation without GPS coordinates
Expected Output: 201 Created; confirmation stored with null coordinates

Objective: Reject GPS coordinates outside valid bounds
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; Range violation (-90 to 90)

Objective: Reallocate a rejected assignment
Expected Output: Assignment status Rejected; shipments unassigned and returned to Created; driver and vehicle released

Objective: Generate an invoice from an order
Expected Output: 201 Created; Invoice at the offering BasePrice; status Unpaid; audit row written

Objective: Settle an invoice by cash without calling the gateway
Expected Output: 200 OK; Receipt issued with GatewayResponse ""N/A""; Invoice Paid; Order Approved
Actual Output: As expected; the payment gateway is not invoked

Objective: Settle an invoice by card through the gateway stub
Expected Output: 200 OK; console message "Payment processed"; Receipt carries that text; Invoice Paid
Actual Output: As expected (no real transaction is performed; per the A3 brief a message is sufficient)

Objective: Settle an invoice by digital wallet
Expected Output: 200 OK; DigitalPayment stores the wallet reference; Receipt issued

Objective: Reject payment when the gateway declines
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Card payment failed."
Actual Output: As expected (exercised with a FakePaymentGateway test double)

Objective: Reject paying an invoice that is already settled
Expected Output: 409 Conflict; "Invoice {id} is already paid."

Objective: Reject an unrecognised payment method
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; rejected by [AllowedValues("Cash","Card","Digital")] before reaching the coordinator

Objective: Retrieve the receipt for a settled invoice
Expected Output: 200 OK with amount; method and issue timestamp

Objective: Create a branch
Expected Output: 201 Created

Objective: Reject a duplicate branch name
Input: A branch name that already exists
Expected Output: 409 Conflict rejecting the duplicate

Objective: Reject a blank branch name
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request from ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace

Objective: Reject a non-positive warehouse capacity
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "CapacityKg must be positive."

Objective: Create each vehicle class with the correct fixed payload
Input: type Light; then Medium; then Heavy
Expected Output: MaxPayloadKg 1000; 5000 and 20000 respectively
Actual Output: As expected; the subclass fixes the capacity

Objective: Edit an existing record (change of mind)
Input: Change a warehouse name and capacity
Expected Output: 200 OK; only the supplied fields change

Objective: Delete a master-data record
Expected Output: 204 No Content; the row is removed

Objective: Reject creating an offering with a non-positive base price
Expected Output: 400 Bad Request; "BasePrice must be positive."

Objective: Generate an operational report
Expected Output: 200 OK; Report with assignment; vehicle; incident and revenue aggregates; audit row written

Objective: Read the dashboard summary aggregates
Expected Output: 200 OK with fleet and order KPI totals

Objective: Page and filter the audit feed
Expected Output: 200 OK with only Order audit rows and a total count

Objective: Report an incident against a vehicle
Expected Output: 201 Created; IncidentRecord persisted and visible in the staff incidents list

Objective: List incidents
Expected Output: 200 OK with the incident list

Objective: Empty state of the order form before input
Expected Output: Form renders with empty fields and a disabled or guarded submit

Objective: Client-side surfacing of a server validation message
Input: Submit an order that violates a domain rule
Expected Output: The ProblemDetails detail text is displayed in the UI rather than a raw HTTP error

Objective: Driver load-manifest checklist blocks an early start
Input: Attempt to start the trip with items unticked
Expected Output: The start action is refused and the reason is shown

Objective: Manager notifications feed refreshes
Input: Leave the page open for one minute
Expected Output: The audit feed polls every 30 seconds and new rows appear
